findings.impact: The STATUS.md canonical tracked-forward register is incomplete for 2 of 7 TF-023C items. Future sessions resuming from STATUS.md context will not see TF-023C-007 (adopter wrapper filename constraint), which is specifically relevant to slice 023D (ADOPT-001 §13 onboarding section). If the 023D dispatch note is authored without TF-023C-007 in context, the onboarding documentation may omit the policy-check.yml naming requirement, perpetuating the hidden constraint that produced CG-MIN-006 in the first place. TF-023C-006 (scp_version floor) is lower-risk (informational not authoritative per invariant 1) but the omission pattern is the same. Both items are low-priority and do not affect slice 023C correctness or safety.
findings.mitigation: Add two entries to STATUS.md in the 'Tracked-forward items from WP-SCP-023 023A + 023B + 023C' section: 'TF-023C-006 (low priority): minimum scp_version check — an adopter pinning a very old SCP version remains verified since the aggregator is informational-not-authoritative (invariant 1); revisit if operator wants a version-floor signal. Filed at 023C R1 MIN-SAFE-002 closure.' and 'TF-023C-007 (low priority): document adopter wrapper filename constraint — the aggregator hardcodes --workflow policy-check.yml in gh run list; a wrapper named anything else produces a confusing no_emit row. Target: slice 023D ADOPT-001 §13 onboarding section. Filed at 023C R1 CG-MIN-006 closure.' Two-line STATUS.md addition; closes the register gap before 023D dispatch.
